text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, on the train platform heading home after finishing some errands, Winning Ticket had a dead serious look on her face...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go on a trip!!
An aimless journey, right now!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Travel is all about being moved!! And you can't be moved on a trip where your destination is already set!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just a one-way ticket in hand!
There's no turning back, and that's what makes it so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Help me find something deeply moving!
I wanna go together with you, Trainer!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Winning Ticket searches for thrills beyond racing.
After the Three Kingdoms and futsal, is traveling next—?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if you've decided to set out on a journey, I'll go with you.
No matter how far, together...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, trains are so awesome!!
It's shaking all over the placeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gwoooooh, buses are so cool!! If nobody's at the stop, they ruthlessly blow right past it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're walking from here on out! Whaaaat,
this is awesooome!! We're moving forward even without any money—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer, how am I gonna get home!?
I seriously only brought enough for a one-way ticket!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ack, that's right!! I can't be
thinking about what comes next aaaggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I have enough money for the return fare,
but I'll keep that to myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, where we arrived was—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... I've really ended up somewhere
completely unfamiliar!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm so moved!! Trainer, this is it, this is what I wanted! A journey just like this...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of amazing, isn't it? A place with no races,
no academy, nothing like that at all...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I'm alive!
I can keep on living!! And so can you, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even without a purpose in life,
we can still go on living. Even without races.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: B-Brrr, it's kinda scary, but so cool!! So this is what a real journey is like...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In an unfamiliar place, she lets her imagination run wild. Traveling so far away seems to have given her a lot to think about.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I only have a little bit
of money left...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If I buy just one more ticket, I feel like I won't be able to leave this spot...
If that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Where should I go, I wonder?
Where should I head toward—
choice_data_list: The place I want to go to the most

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: As far as I can possibly go...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Now that we've come this far,
we have no choice but to go all out!! Alriiiight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stopped thinking and charged straight ahead.
And the place I arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! The ocean!!
We've finally gone as far as we can goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Trainer, we really gotta push it to the limit without being scared!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOAAAH, I'm amayyyzing!
And now, and nooowww!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyooone, gooodbyyyyye!!
Don't forgid abouuuud meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOOOOOOOOOONNNN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She believed she would never see her friends again.
That was the resolve she came with.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's totally fine! I'll just live here
and catch tuna for the rest of my lifeee!!
choice_data_list: No, let's head home. By taxi.
No, let's take a taxi home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking the wallet out of the pocket—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, why do you have one of those~!?
I told you it was a one-way ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, thaaank yooouuu!!
I'll pay you back li'l by li'l, I promissse!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tears of joy stream down her face.
It seems this perilous journey has built up her courage.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
An unknown place... That's true... Even if I
don't recognize where we are, we're still somewhere in Japan...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO, I wanna go somewhere
even more mind-boggling! I wanna gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Charging forward heedlessly, the place she finally reached was...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, we're safe here!!
It's totally incomprehensible!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"For some reason, I can see Earth in the sky,
and there's barely any air!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, my body feels
super light! Like, boing, boing!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go for a quick run!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And the next day.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin, Taishin!!
Listen, listen, listen, it's amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I went to the moon yesterday!
Whoaaaa, I'm a Space Horse Girl!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What's that supposed to mean?
choice_data_list: I fell asleep in the taxi on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Pretty much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to the auto-suggestion that she had run on the moon,
Winning Ticket managed to run a little faster.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The place I want to go most...
I see. Yeah, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If I can never move from here again,
then I want to go to the place I love most...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the train as far as it would go,
and then walking for hours, the place we finally arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived...
Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The place where the Derby is held.
This truly is where I belong...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
This is the only goal for us!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day I watched the Derby and was inspired,
all this time...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I bought it a long time ago.
A one-way ticket with no turning back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My wish to come here hasn't changed!!
Even if I can never go back, I'm totally fine with it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And I figured that out on this journey!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going on a journey is
a way to rediscover where you truly belong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed the same was true for Winning Ticket as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, this trip might be
coming to an end, but—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue our journey!!
So that we may return here time and time again!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Even after the Derby ends, major target races are always being held here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed a new strength had awakened within Winning Ticket
as she renewed her resolve.
